answer_1.quote: We apply DENIAL PROMPTING on Codeforces, a challenging Text-to-Code task where model solutions can be automatically verified and allows comparison to substantial historical human solutions.

answer_2.quote: We propose NEOGAUGE score ( §4) which involves (1) verifying the correctness of the LLM-generated solution and whether it adheres to the specified constraints from DENIAL PROMPTING (convergent thinking), and (2) assessing solution novelty by contrasting it with techniques previously used in human solutions (divergent thinking).

answer_3.quote: We use the same augmentation model P LM to detect atomic techniques (e.g., recursion, for loop, hashmaps, etc.), used in y 1 to solve x with a technique detection prompt.
